name: High Wilderness
summary: In western Feralas, the High Wilderness runs from the Verdantis River to the Forgotten Coast. Its towering trees shelter wildlife, wandering treants, and dangerous beasts.

sections.title: The Primordial Canopy
sections.body: The High Wilderness spreads across western Feralas beneath trees so vast and foliage so thick that little sky shows through. Wolves, bears, hippogryphs, and yetis roam below. Ancient treants wander among the roots, while aggressive ogre clans hold shaded clearings. Brush hides predators and hazards from an earlier age, so travelers must stay alert.

faq.q: Where is the High Wilderness located?
faq.answer: The High Wilderness covers the forestlands of western Feralas, west of the Verdantis River. It reaches the cliffs and shores along the Forgotten Coast.

faq.q: What creatures roam the High Wilderness?
faq.answer: Bears, wolves, hippogryphs, and feral yetis roam the forest. Wandering treants and aggressive ogres also dwell beneath the canopy.

angles.text: The ancient treants and vibrant wildlife of the High Wilderness reveal Kalimdor's primal strength, untouched by civilization in the eastern lands.
Fierce bears, wolves, and wild hippogryphs fill the High Wilderness, where you can track and tame formidable beasts.
